title: Menus can cause overflow when there are a lot of them and space is limited on a horizontal panel
line: Apps with many menus no longer push the system tray and clock off the panel: menus that don't fit go into an overflow menu at the end of the Global Menu.
explanation: The Global Menu set its minimum width to the full width of all its menu buttons, so the panel had to give it that much room no matter what; with many menus it squeezed the task manager to nothing and pushed the tray, clock and Show Desktop off the panel. The change makes it ask for its full width only as preferred size and for one button as minimum, hides the menus that don't fit the width it gets, and shows an overflow button (overflow-menu icon) that opens them as submenus. Keyboard Left/Right and hovering between buttons while a menu is open move into and out of the overflow menu.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: move menus that don't fit into an overflow menu

The Global Menu asked the panel for the width of all its menus, so apps
with many menus pushed the tray and clock off the panel. It now needs
room for one button only and puts the menus that don't fit in a menu.

BUG: 396404

media.caption: Master: an app with 30 menus; the menus run off the right edge and the tray, clock and Show Desktop are gone
With the fix: Menu1–Menu8 fit, an overflow button follows, the tray and clock stay
Opening the overflow button lists Menu9–Menu30 and Search as submenus; hovering moves between it and the panel buttons

review.text: Well-structured solution to a long-standing Global Menu panel overflow bug: setting Layout.minimumWidth to one button and Layout.preferredWidth to menusWidth avoids feedback loops with GridLayout while keeping sibling widgets on the panel, and moving excess menus into a dedicated overflow QMenu preserves submenus, hover switching, and Left/Right keyboard navigation. Minor polish ideas (guarding overflowButton.activated() on overflowButton.visible in onRequestActivateIndex/onActivated and using Math.min(menusWidth, overflowButton.implicitWidth) for minimumWidth) are harmless edge cases and not merge blockers.
